Specification: This module defines a collection of recursive utility operators over finite sets, sequences, and functions. It specifies computations for summing a set of numbers, taking the union of a set of sets, filtering a sequence by a predicate, counting how many elements of a set satisfy a predicate, computing the range of a sequence, finding a mode of a sequence, and checking whether a function is injective. The module contains no state variables, no actions, and no temporal behavior; it is a purely functional helper module built around recursive definitions and choice expressions.
IfThenElse: IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN x + Sum(S \ {x})
IF setOfSets = {} THEN {} ELSE LET S == CHOOSE x \in setOfSets : TRUE IN S \union BigUnion(setOfSets \ {x})
IF seq = <<>> THEN <<>> ELSE LET tail == SelectSeq(Tail(seq), Test) IN IF Test( Head(seq) ) THEN <<Head(seq)>> \o tail ELSE tail
IF Test( Head(seq) ) THEN <<Head(seq)>> \o tail ELSE tail
IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET x == CHOOSE y \in S : TRUE IN (IF P(x) THEN 1 ELSE 0) + Quantify(S \ {x}, P)
IF seq = <<>> THEN elIfEmpty ELSE LET numOf(p) == Quantify( DOMAIN seq, LAMBDA q: q = p ) IN CHOOSE x \in Range(seq): \A y \in Range(seq) : numOf(x) >= numOf(y)
ChoiceExpr: CHOOSE x \in Range(seq): \A y \in Range(seq) : numOf(x) >= numOf(y)
